title: adaptive-signal-attenuator-and-stepwise-playbook-generator
author: Samira Alvarez
description: Motivation: On-call noise and low-signal alerts keep interrupting responders and dilute attention away from high-impact incidents. This PR introduces two complementary features: (1) an adaptive signal attenuator that temporarily mutes or down-prioritizes low-signal alert bursts based on multivariate heuristics (entity cardinality, recent noise history, error-rate delta), and (2) a stepwise playbook generator that converts canonical runbook templates into prioritized, step-by-step remediation checklists with embedded conditional telemetry checks. Both are exposed via the incident-bot core and a new CLI surface (oncallctl) and are designed for safe gradual rollout with canary attenuation and an explicit override flow.
summary: Adds adaptive signal-attenuator (rate/entropy-based suppression) + stepwise-playbook-generator (templated, telemetry-aware playbooks). CLI commands: oncallctl attenuate, oncallctl compose-playbook. Integrates with snapshot composer to attach a minimal telemetry bundle when playbooks are created.

ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky on first run, rerun OK)
qa_notes: Local test harness included (e2e/attenuator_e2e_test.sh). QA should validate: (1) attenuation dry-run output matches live decision, (2) UI displays reason_code and provides an immediate 'unmute' button, (3) false_suppression_count increments on suppressed alerts that later escalate, (4) playbook steps created by compose-playbook contain conditional telemetry checks and a top-level priority score.
rolling_strategy: Feature gated by flag 'feature.attenuator_v1'. Default off for orgs with < 24h paging SLA. We rollout in three phases: dev, 10% canary, org-wide. Canary can be disabled via admin console or oncallctl attenuate --disable-canary.
migration_notes: No DB migrations. New metrics (attenuator.*) and small schema add to incident metadata: 'suppression' block added to alert documents. Backwards-compatible: absent block => treated as not suppressed.
docs_changed: Added operational guide docs/oncall/attenuator.md with rationale, attenuation heuristics, safe rollback, metrics to monitor, and recommended playbook templates. Also added CLI usage examples and troubleshooting.
ui_integration: incident_viewer now surfaces suppression banners with reason_code and 'unmute' action; hooks into oncallctl via web socket for immediate unmute requests.
security_considerations: Attenuator runs within existing incident-bot service boundary and honors RBAC. 'unmute' is an action gated by oncall role. No external network calls introduced besides snapshot composer which calls existing telemetry ingest endpoint.
release_notes: Introduce adaptive signal attenuator (opt-in) to reduce low-signal paging noise and a stepwise playbook generator to create prioritized remediation steps. CLI: oncallctl attenuate, oncallctl compose-playbook. Feature-gated and rolled out canary-first.
post_merge_tasks: Monitor attenuator.false_suppression_count and alert if > 0.5% over baseline for 2h. Add a dashboard tile in SRE views to track suppression rate, allowed_rate, and median time-to-action on suppressed incidents.
notes: This PR was requested as part of SRE noise-reduction initiative in ENG-7821. The design prioritizes explainability for responders and explicit quick-unmute controls to avoid blind suppression. Consider follow-up work: ML-based classification model for suppression instead of heuristics, and a 'learned' policy that adapts thresholds per service over time.
